_comment: Corrections applied to facet vocabularies at export time.
These are curation fixes for values that should not appear in a public facet.
They are applied here, not upstream, so the export stays reproducible from an
unmodified extract and every correction is visible in one reviewable file.
Map: tag group -> { original value -> replacement, or null to drop the value }.
Dropping a value removes it from that asset only; the asset keeps its other
values for the same group, and is never removed from the corpus.
Values that are unfit to be a facet label by their shape rather than by their
identity are handled generically in allowlist.py, so they do not need an entry
here and do not have to be written down to be suppressed.
